name: build-fleet
description: Spec-driven multi-agent software house: product-owner, architect, coder, qa, devops, scribe, and classifier subagents executing a hook-gated SPEC → REVIEW → FINALIZE → BUILD → CHANGE_REVIEW → HANDOFF state machine, with a human-ratified product planning tier and a reproducing-test-gated bug lane. Deterministic gates, bounded review cycles, first-class human escalation, headless orchestrator support.
